cohortEnvironment.coldScope: First PrepareDeferred in this executable invocation, after native harness and parent Item/Player construction. Not process startup timing. No dump or full catalog setup.
cohortEnvironment.resetScope: ParentAnalysis.Invalidate clears shared source/attack caches; native certificate Lazy values and CLR/JIT state remain warm. Source-cache-reset is not a fresh process.
cohortEnvironment.allocationScope: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(precise:true) process-wide delta across PrepareDeferred, Task.Run(CompleteAnalysis), 16ms Pump/waits and PayloadJson access; includes worker/main/runtime observer overhead, excludes parent construction, invalidation, parity parsing, hashing and evidence writes. Cumulative managed allocation, not retained/peak RAM. No forced GC.
cohortEnvironment.gcScope: Process-wide GC.CollectionCount generation deltas over the same pipeline interval; prior-phase garbage can be collected here.

limits: One fresh-process cold measurement per scenario and variant in each cohort; no statistical worst-case or p95 guarantee.
Cold interval is PrepareDeferred through CompleteAnalysis and PayloadJson, after parent construction; it excludes application startup and model/API traffic.
Source-cache-reset is not a new process; CLR/JIT and lazy certificates remain warm.
Cumulative managed allocations are not peak/retained memory. Linux RSS covers the entire subprocess including all four phases and evidence writes.
No Calamity/modded loadout, client tooltip hooks, world/gameplay/GPU or multiplayer validation.
Packs are tied to exact native, decompiler, runtime dependency bytes and source projections; an incompatible pack uses the unchanged live source reader.
The earlier 200 MB memory goal is not met.
